name: Skytech, Inc.
summary: Skytech, Inc. engages in the provision of professional services in the semiconductor and related technology industries. It offers physical vapor deposition (PVD) equipment, Atomic layer deposition (ALD) equipment, bonder and debonder equipment, as well as semiconductor equipment spare parts and related services. The company was founded on July 17, 2002 and is headquartered in Zhubei, Taiwan.
